title: Self-Joins for Hierarchical and Comparative Analysis
realWorldScenario: An organizational chart table `employees (id, name, manager_id)` stores both workers and their direct managers in the same table.
questionStatement: What is a Self-Join? Write a query showing how to retrieve each employee's name along with their manager's name. Why must a LEFT JOIN be used if top executives have no manager?
expectedConcepts: LEFT JOIN necessity for root nodes (NULL manager_id)
hints: Alias the table twice: once as employee, once as manager.
